name: nGZGraphic4::ClipCopyRects
notes: Lane OS (rendering R3b step 4): the copy clip, cdecl (source rect, source bounds, target rect, target bounds). Pure function of the eight rectangles, so the test (gz_SurfaceCopy_Clip, 40000 seeded rectangle sets: ordinary, inverted, zero-width (0/0 NaN), empty bounds, a 2:1 scale case) runs the original at its RVA against ours and compares the result and both rectangles byte for byte. The float steps follow the original's SSE: the target cut computed from the source's cut in single precision (cvtsi2ss, mulss/divss/addss/subss in the original's order), the fail tests written as `a >= b` so a NaN passes (comiss + jae), the cuts by max/min, cvttss2si back to integers. In effect through callers (all five callers are ours: cSurfaceDX StretchRect, cDraw2D DrawImage, cImageManipDX LoadSurfaceFromMemoryRect and CopySurfaceRect, cDeviceEnumDX CanStretchRect). Mutants in the entry for 0x1614b0 (one mutant list for the file).

name: nGZGraphic4::CanStretchRectDX
notes: Lane OS (rendering R3b step 4): whether Direct3D's StretchRect can do a copy between two surfaces (cdecl, 8 arguments; the filter out-argument). Difftest gz_SurfaceCopy_CanStretch (2000 seeded worlds x 3 calls, source and target the same face one time in five): the surface faces (cISurfaceDX: GetSurface for the access flags, GetDevice), the device (GetDeviceEnum45), the device enumeration (CanStretchRect answers a seeded bit per call, GetCaps with seeded filter caps) and the pixel formats with the formats manager the getter 0x18acd0 hands out (stood in on both sides) are drawfx fakes; compared: the log (every call with its arguments: the kinds table's values, the sizes, rectangles and formats), the result and the filter (preset to garbage, so a write on false shows). Table 0xd9db08 is read through GameAddress. In effect through callers (cSurfaceDX StretchRect and the copy 0x1614b0, both ours). original_calls: the formats getter 0x18acd0 (the manager's static instance).

name: nGZGraphic4::CopySurfaceRectLocked
notes: Lane OS (rendering R3b step 4): copies a rectangle between two Direct3D surfaces by locking both (source read-only, target no-syslock) and copying rows of width x bits-per-pixel / 8 bytes, rows = height / block height (at least 1). Refuses (false) a default-pool, non-dynamic surface that has a container (a texture level), logs a failed GetDesc, unlocks the source when the target lock fails. Difftest gz_SurfaceCopy_Locked (3000 seeded worlds): d3dfx::Level surfaces (seeded description, pitch, lock and unlock results, container with success / S_FALSE / E_NOINTERFACE) and the pixel formats; compared: the log (every call, LogD3DError lines with their line numbers), the result, every pixel buffer and the lock counts. In effect through callers (only the copy 0x1614b0). original_calls: 0x18acd0.

name: nGZGraphic4::MakeSystemMemorySurfaceLike
notes: Lane OS (rendering R3b step 4): a system-memory twin of a surface: of its container's kind (texture: CreateTexture then level 0; cube texture: CreateCubeTexture then face 0 level 0; another container: fails) when GetContainer answers exactly 0, else CreateOffscreenPlainSurface; releases the container then the device. Difftest gz_SurfaceCopy_Twin (3000 seeded worlds): Level surfaces with seeded containers (types texture, cube, other; answers 0, S_FALSE, E_NOINTERFACE) and the device's Create* by d3dfx::Script (results per call, a failed create can still hand out an object); compared: the log, the result and the three out-pointers, the reference counts. In effect through callers (only the copy 0x1614b0).

name: nGZGraphic4::CopySurfaceRectDX
notes: Lane OS (rendering R3b step 4): copies a rectangle of one surface to a point of another, clipped to both surfaces, by the way the usage and pools allow: a render target source: GetRenderTargetData when it is the whole surface into a system-memory one of its size, else StretchRect (default-pool target when CanStretchRectDX agrees), else the locked copy (lockable source) or through a system-memory twin; other sources by the pair of pools: StretchRect (with the scene ended around it for a depth-stencil source in a scene), the locked copy, UpdateSurface, or the target's twin and UpdateSurface. Difftest gz_SurfaceCopy_Copy (6000 seeded worlds): the faces, device, enumeration, formats, Level surfaces with containers and the device's Create* script as in the others (the device's GetRenderTargetData and UpdateSurface copy the source buffer); the source rectangle and point seeded (whole, outside, empty, inverted in height); compared: every call on every fake, the LogD3DError lines, the result, the reference counts, every pixel buffer and lock count; the sweep fails when no device copy, lock, report or create ran. In effect through callers (cSurfaceDX CopyRect and Copy, both ours). original_calls: none besides those of its callees (0x18acd0 in 0x160ef0 and 0x162d60). Mutants for the whole file (tools/mutate.py, 33 distinct, 29 + 4 reruns): 31 killed by the five tests (the clip's rectangle cuts and fail tests, the kinds-table index, the filter choice, the pool and flag tests, the lock flags and unlock order, the row count and row bytes, the container tests, the twin's create arguments and release order, the clipped rectangle and point, the scene end and begin, the multisample test, the WaitForGpu call, the GetRenderTargetData point test, the UpdateSurface point arguments); two mutants did not build (replaced by building ones); one equivalent: `targetLeft >= boundsRight` to `>` (and its three mirrors) in 0x18ce70, because at equality the cut width is 0 and the later `1.0f > cutRight - cutLeft` test returns false anyway.
